description: Software-engineering memory: services, migrations, limits, corrections.

items.content: The auth service signs access tokens with RS256 (RSA) JWT and rotates its JWKS every 24 hours; legacy HS256 tokens are rejected at the gateway.
Migration 0042 moved session storage from Redis to Postgres because Redis memory pressure was evicting sessions early; rollback plan is documented in ops/migrations/0042.md.
The product metadata cache uses a 60-second TTL with stale-while-revalidate; catalog updates invalidate the tag 'product-metadata'.
The public API enforces a rate limit of 500 requests per minute per token, documented in api/limits.md.
Correction (2026-06): after the edge cache rollout, the public API rate limit was raised to 1000 requests per minute per token. api/limits.md updated accordingly.
The billing worker reads its queue region from the environment variable BILLING_REGION; deployments fail closed if it is unset.
Correction (2026-07): the billing worker's queue region variable was renamed to BILLING_QUEUE_REGION; BILLING_REGION is now ignored and a deprecation warning is logged.
Tenant migration step 1: run the backfill job that copies user.account_id into user.tenant_id for all rows (idempotent, resumable).
Tenant migration step 2: create a composite index on (tenant_id, email) only after the backfill reports zero false rows.
Tenant migration step 3: enable dual-write for account creation and monitor the mismatch metric for 72 hours before cutting reads over.
The frontend lint rules were updated to eslint 9 with flat config; prettier remains the formatter.
CI runners moved to ubuntu-24.04 images; the build caching layer stayed the same.
The observability agent emits Prometheus metrics on port 9102 with a 15s scrape interval.
